title: Automated Test Execution Framework — Overview and definition

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Runs scripted hardware and software tests unattended with fixtures and reporting. An automated test execution framework sequences test steps, drives instruments and devices under test through fixtures, captures results, and retries flaky steps with backoff. Real implementations include pytest with hardware plugins, Robot Framework, and NI TestStand. It parallelizes across stations, quarantines failures, and produces traceable reports.

t: Automated Test Execution Framework — Actual implementation
description: Runs scripted hardware and software tests unattended with fixtures and reporting.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. How Automated Test Execution Framework is actually implemented. An automated test execution framework sequences test steps, drives instruments and devices under test through fixtures, captures results, and retries flaky steps with backoff. Real implementations combine Python/Robot DSL, GUI sequencer, CI integration (JUnit XML) with Instrument drivers, a result database, CI runner. The implementation is verified by Verify with a known-good and known-bad DUT: the framework passes the good unit, fails the bad one at the right step, and the report links every result to its script revision

t: Automated Test Execution Framework — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Runs scripted hardware and software tests unattended with fixtures and reporting.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Automated Test Execution Framework, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Sequenced test steps with setup/teardown and fixtures). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Sequenced test steps with setup/teardown and fixtures and Instrument and DUT control through a unified adapter layer. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Engineering test-plan generator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
